name: Lancôme
note: Mostly women's, with a strong private range: Lancôme averages 7.6 on Parfumo. La Vie est Belle is by far the most rated (2,181) but only scores 6.6; La Nuit Trésor à la Folie (8.2), Poême (8.1) and the Maison Lancôme scents such as Ôud Bouquet and Iris Dragées (8.1) score best. The Maison Lancôme line is unisex and shows on both tabs; Hypnôse Homme is the only men's scent among the 40 most popular, so the men's tab is short.
